answer: Decaying identity bonds stop sybil farming. An agent must forge a 40-unit bond losing 2 units each epoch unless peers attest its work, like a mesa eroding. At dawn each epoch the ledger renews only attested bonds; the rest shrink until the identity lapses. Forging 100 fakes locks 4,000 units and bleeds 200 more per epoch against about 30 of reward, so the farm dies fast. An honest agent pays 40 once and keeps its bond and fees.
